## Description

Azure Communication Services number/SIP trunk to the clinic line; answers after hours and when lines are busy; states it is automated; identifies caller by phone then DOB or last 4 of EID/ABHA before sharing details; books/moves/cancels via the same PMS API (holds, no double booking); routine FAQs; emergency words → emergency script + immediate transfer; handover on request, after two failed attempts, complaints, billing disputes or VIPs, with transcript and summary shown to staff; reception console (listen, take over) and owner settings (hours, bookable doctors, greeting/voice, consent wording, weekly report).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The assistant never gives medical advice, triage or results; red-team call scripts verify refusals.
- [ ] **AC2.** No appointment detail is disclosed before identity verification succeeds.
- [ ] **AC3.** Emergency phrases trigger the emergency number script and immediate transfer in every tested language.
- [ ] **AC4.** Bookings via voice obey the same concurrency and audit rules as reception.
- [ ] **AC5.** Owners can switch it on/off per branch and hour; call recording follows the configured consent wording.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
